## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and the boundary it affects.

## Verification

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`
- [ ] Relevant unit/UI tests
- [ ] Real build or platform smoke when runtime behavior changed
- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints, proprietary SDKs, or generated output
- [ ] Submodule changes preserve upstream provenance and were tested together

## Distribution impact

Explain whether community, official, or enterprise configuration changes the
behavior. Application behavior should not require a private source fork.
